name: Nunca Ando Sola AI: You and the Holy Shadows
blurb: Nunca ando sola ("I never walk alone") is a TikTok AI photo trend from Mexico and the US: you from behind on a golden path, with the haloed shadows of Jesus, Saint Jude and the Virgin of Guadalupe beside your own.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Back view of the person kneeling on a sunlit path at golden hour. Next to their long shadow are three shadows with halos: Jesus, Saint Jude with a staff, and the Virgin of Guadalupe. Photo-real, 9:16, like a real phone photo taken by a friend standing a few steps behind and a little above. The person kneels in the middle of a light concrete garden path, both knees on the ground, the back straight, the head slightly bowed, the hands joined in prayer in front of the chest, hidden by the body. The person keeps exactly the hair color, hair length and hairstyle, the skin tone, the body shape and size, the age and the clothes from the uploaded image; if the photo shows only the front, continue the same clothes and the same hair naturally on the back. No human face is visible anywhere in the picture: we see only the back of the person's head. A low, warm sun shines from behind the camera, so long shadows stretch forward up the path, away from the camera. Ahead of the person, larger than life and side by side, lie the three holy shadows: on the left the shadow of Saint Jude Thaddeus, standing, holding a tall staff; in the middle the shadow of Jesus in a long robe, one hand raised in blessing; on the right the shadow of the Virgin of Guadalupe, a mantle over her head and her hands joined, framed by an oval of pointed sun rays. The path has green grass along one side and the dappled shadows of tree leaves at the top of the frame. They are only shadows: dark, soft-edged silhouettes with a thin round halo ring around each head, with no faces, no features, no colors and no painted details. Nobody stands there: no figures, statues or people cast them. Calm, warm, hopeful and respectful. Exactly one person. No text, no captions, no stickers, no logos, no watermark, no frame.
